stories.title: New inquest hope for siblings found dead in farmhouse 50 years ago
stories.summary: Family members believe Griff Thomas did not murder his sister Martha and want him to be pardoned.

stories.title: Reform's Joe Martin given Senedd speaking ban after he said white people are being replaced
stories.summary: Presiding Officer Huw Irranca-Davies said Joe Martin's comments were clearly "offensive"

stories.title: Deal agreed to end health visitor strike affecting baby appointments
stories.summary: Health visitors are set to return to work next week, ending a nine-month dispute over pay and grading.

stories.title: Cerys Matthews pays tribute to her family as she receives OBE
stories.summary: Matthews was behind the Welsh rock band Catatonia who shot to fame during the "Cool Cymru" movement of the 1990s.

stories.title: New body will look at case for Welsh independence, and more devolution
stories.summary: Welsh government launches new commission, which will look at case for Wales going it alone.

stories.title: ITV Wales plans to cut programmes and jobs
stories.summary: Coast and Country and Backstage face the axe, while ITV Wales plans to cut producer roles.

stories.title: Thousands of 'off-grid' homes eligible for £250 to help with heating bills
stories.summary: Households dependent on either heating oil or LPG and are eligible for reduced council tax will benefit.

stories.title: Dad high on cocaine who stole minibus, drove wrong way on A55 and hit a cyclist jailed
stories.summary: Darragh O’Grady also hit a cyclist, leaving him unconscious and with two broken ribs and a cut liver.

stories.title: Backlash after councillor tells Russell Brand to 'stay strong'
stories.summary: Bridgend council rejects Owain Clatworthy's comments and it stands "firmly with victims and survivors of sexual abuse".

stories.title: Festival headlined by Andrea Bocelli scraps choirs fee after backlash
stories.summary: The Land of Song Festival organisers admit they "got it wrong" and will refund individual fees paid.

stories.title: I almost died after a toothache led to sepsis and a rare heart condition
stories.summary: Doctors told Danny Ellis it was a "miracle" he was alive after his first heart surgery failed.

stories.title: Ioan Gruffudd in AI warning after fan claimed they had been in year-long affair
stories.summary: The Aberdare actor urged fans not to send money, saying "explicit and disturbing" images are "not me".
